svg.aria-label: Not converted to SVG. The display lettering is hand-drawn lithography. 'CARVER & THE FLOOD' carries a drawn outline and a cast shadow that are part of each letter rather than an effect applied to a face, the strokes swell and taper by hand, and the words are fitted around the dancer rather than set on a line. Resetting them in a typeface would remove the thing the style consists of. Measured, 71 bands are rejected against 25 kept, and the copy cannot be aligned better than a mean cost of 1.07.
